title: A study testing the safety and possible benefits of an ear injection of a new compound, Paliroden, in people with type 2 diabetes who have difficulty understanding speech in noisy situations
official: A RANDOMIZED, DOUBLE-BLIND, PLACEBO-CONTROLLED, ASCENDING VOLUME PHASE 1B/2A CLINICAL TRIAL TO INVESTIGATE THE SAFETY AND EFFICACY OF A SINGLE TRANSTYMPANIC INJECTION OF CIL001 (PALIRODEN) FOR THE TREATMENT OF COCHLEAR SYNAPTOPATHY IN PARTICIPANTS WITH TYPE2 DIABETES
summary:
Primary Safety Objective: 1. To assess the safety and tolerability of paliroden (CIL001) in Participants with type 2 diabetes, over 6 months (168 days) post-transtympanic (TT) injection.
Main Efficacy Objective: 1. Improvement in speech in noise (SIN) intelligibility at day 84 (D84) post-injection.
conditions: Cochlear Synaptopathy in participants with type2 diabetes
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. At the screening visit (V0):: 1. Signed and dated informed consent form
2. At the baseline visit (V1): 1. Normal hearing as defined by PTAv (0.5-1-2kHz-4Khz) <25dB in both ears.
3. At the baseline visit (V1): 2. Up to mild hearing loss in the high-frequency range (PTAvHF (4-6-8kHz) <40dB) in both ears.
4. At the baseline visit (V1): 3. Presence of otoacoustic emissions (≥ 7 dB SNR) at minimum 3 different frequencies among 1, 2, 4 and 8kHz.
5. At the baseline visit (V1): 4. A confirmed Speech-in-noise deficit (at least 3dB SNR loss in comparison to normative value of the Matrix test) in both ears.
6. At the baseline visit (V1): 5. WOCBP must have a negative urine pregnancy test at baseline (pre-dose).
7. At the baseline visit (V1): 6. Male Participants with partners of childbearing potential must use barrier contraception and ensure that their partners use a highly effective method during the same period (see section 5.6 Contraception).
8. At the baseline visit (V1): 7. Willing and able to protect the ear canal and middle ear from water exposure for as long as the tympanic membrane was not fully closed.
9. At the screening visit (V0): 2. Aged between 45 and 75 years old (inclusive) at the time of screening
10. At the screening visit (V0): 3. Established type 2 diabetes as determined by 7% ≤ hemoglobin A1c (HbA1c) ≤ 9% and diabetes duration of at least 5 years. If older than 3 months, needs to be assessed.  needs to
11. At the screening visit (V0): 4. Be considered as reliable and capable of adhering to the protocol, according to the judgment of the Investigator
12. At the screening visit (V0): 5. Participants must be native speakers of the official language(s) of the country in which the study assessments are conducted
13. At the screening visit (V0): 6. Women of childbearing potential (WOCBP) must have a negative serum pregnancy test upon entry into this study. In addition, they must agree to use highly effective contraception methods, as defined by regulatory guidance (e.g., combined hormonal contraception, intrauterine device, or surgical sterilization), from the screening visit, for the duration of study treatment and for 30 days after dosing The following audiology assessments, if not performed on the same day as the review of the previous criteria (e.g., when the participant’s first visit does not take place at the ENT site), may be scheduled on different days within a maximum interval of 14 days after the first screening visit and must be completed at least 21 days before the baseline visit.
14. At the screening visit (V0): 7. Normal hearing as defined by PTAv (0.5-1-2kHz-4Khz) <25dB in both ears
15. At the screening visit (V0): 8. Up to mild hearing loss in the high-frequency range (PTAvHF (4-6-8kHz) <40dB) in both ears.
16. At the screening visit (V0): 9. Speech-in-noise deficit (at least 3dB SNR loss in comparison to normative value of the Matrix test) in both ears.
Exclusion criteria:
1. At the screening visit (V0): 1. MoCA score < 26
2. At the screening visit (V0): 18. Major surgery that may impact the study conduct or outcomes within eight weeks before screening or scheduled/planned surgery within the time frame of the study.
3. At the screening visit (V0): 2. Known otologic pathology (e.g., History of autoimmune hearing loss, radiation-induced hearing loss, fluctuating hearing, endolymphatic hydrops, or Menière’s disease in either ear)
4. At the baseline visit (V1): 1. Abnormal otoscopy as defined by less than 90% of the tympanic membrane visible (e.g., cerumen ear plug, ear drum perforation). In case of cerumen plugs not affecting the hearing results, a removal must be scheduled before treatment dispensation.
5. At the baseline visit (V1): 2. Abnormal tympanogram (other than type A).
6. At the baseline visit (V1): 3. Conductive hearing loss (>10 dB difference between air- and bone-conduction hearing thresholds, with air-conduction thresholds > 20 dB in PTAv (0.5, 1, 2, 4 kHz)
7. At the baseline visit (V1): 4. Asymmetric hearing thresholds (more than 15 dB difference in PTAv (0.5, 1, 2, 4 kHz) between left and right ear)
8. At the screening visit (V0): 3. Presence of middle ear pathology or infections (e.g., active otitis media, or other ear infections, tympanic membrane perforation, etc.)
9. At the screening visit (V0): 4. History of cancer treated by platinum-based chemotherapy
10. At the screening visit (V0): 5. Previous or concurrent malignancies that require treatment and are not clinically stable
11. At the screening visit (V0): 6. Current evidence or history of retrocochlear pathology (e.g., acoustic neuroma)
12. At the screening visit (V0): 10. Lactation or known pregnancy or positive pregnancy test at both screening and baseline for women of childbearing potential, or planning to become pregnant during the study
13. At the screening visit (V0): 7. History of otologic surgery (apart from tympanostomy tube insertion if more than one year prior to inclusion visit)
14. At the screening visit (V0): 8. Abnormal otoscopy as defined by less than 90% of the tympanic membrane visible (e.g., cerumen ear plug, ear drum perforation). In case of cerumen plugs not affecting the hearing results, a removal must be scheduled before V1 (baseline/inclusion).
15. At the screening visit (V0): 9. Hearing aids and cochlear implants.
16. At the screening visit (V0): 11. Liver Function markers within the prior 2 months (or assessed if not available at screening).: a. Bilirubin (direct and total) > 2 times the upper limit of normal (ULN) b. Alanine aminotransferase (ALT) or aspartate aminotransferase (AST) (AST/ALT) >5 times ULN, or c. Gamma glutamyltransferase (GGT) > 5 times ULN
17. At the screening visit (V0): 12. Maternally Inherited Diabetes
18. At the screening visit (V0): 13. Congenital hearing loss
19. At the screening visit (V0): 14. Untreated hypothyroidism
20. At the screening visit (V0): 15. Adult individual under legal protection as defined by applicable regulations (e.g., persons deprived of liberty, hospitalized without consent, unable to provide informed consent, or placed under legal guardianship or curatorship)
21. At the screening visit (V0): 16. Concurrent participation in another clinical study or participation in another trial involving experimental drug within 30 days or five half-lives of the experimental drug (whichever was longer) prior to screening visit (V0).
22. At the screening visit (V0): 17. Diagnosed anxiety disorders, psychosis, depression, schizophrenia, attempted suicide, or other significant psychiatric conditions that could impact their ability to cooperate and comply with the study protocol
